browserCacheConfiguration.claim: Native BFCache is permitted but eligibility and use depend on actual Chromium/application behavior. History traversal alone does not prove a BFCache hit.

bfCacheObservation.interpretation: Only native trusted pageshow persisted:true proves an observed BFCache restoration. A zero count is not a product failure and does not qualify cached-document restoration; successful history/reload can still qualify the observed fresh-navigation route. Actual no-store and other browser reasons may legitimately prevent restoration.
